test_title: PYST 211: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 1st Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Chirag, firoz, Hira, Joy and Lohit are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Lohit is to the immediate right of Firoz. Chirag is to the immediate left of Joy. Only Hira is between Lohit and Chirag. Who is at the third right place of Firoz?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Chirag, firoz, Hira, Joy and Lohit are sitting in a straight line facing the north.

1) Only Hira is between Lohit and Chirag and Lohit is to the immediate right of Firoz and Chirag is to the immediate left of Joy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf48f368018ed6e63724dc953da564c8dfadd2372231dd07edaade74eceeae3c.png] 

∴ Here, 'Chirag' is at third right place of Firoz.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Chirag".**
